info.title: 语学星 v2 API Contract
info.description: Phase 1 API 的 canonical 契约基线。外部调用只经 Gateway 的 /api/v1 边界；JSON 是 API 单一事实源，详细业务域接口按同一 envelope、错误、分页、幂等、追踪与版本约定增量接入。

servers.description: 本地 API Gateway 固定端口；外部 API 的唯一入口

correlation.serverBehavior: The gateway accepts a valid client request ID or generates a replacement; every response returns the final request ID and trace ID.

writeIdempotency.binding: The server persists the request-body digest and first terminal response for the key scope.
writeIdempotency.replay: The same key and digest returns the original terminal response; the same key with a different digest returns HTTP 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
writeIdempotency.writeOperations: POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE declare x-idempotency; required writes reference IdempotencyKeyRequired.
writeIdempotency.exceptionRule: An exception is allowed only for a non-persistent operation whose response intentionally must not replay a prior credential. It must name the owner, explain the safe behavior, and cannot bypass idempotency for a domain command.

pagination.stability: A cursor is opaque, server-issued and bound to its filter/sort snapshot; clients must not decode, edit or reuse it with different filters.

400.meaning: The request syntax, required headers or request parameters are invalid; business validation of a well-formed body uses HTTP 422.

401.meaning: Credentials are missing, invalid, expired or revoked; clients may perform one controlled refresh only where a refresh credential is valid.

403.meaning: The principal is authenticated but the server-derived policy denies the action. 401 and 403 must never be represented as an empty result.

404.meaning: The requested resource does not exist or is intentionally hidden by the applicable visibility policy.

409.meaning: The request is syntactically valid but conflicts with current state, an optimistic version or an idempotency binding.

422.meaning: The JSON shape is understood but domain validation rejected one or more safe, field-addressable values.

429.meaning: A gateway or owner-service rate limit was exceeded; Retry-After is required and clients must back off.

5xx.meaning: The server failed or an upstream dependency timed out. Error details must remain safe for clients and must not expose secrets, stack traces or protected domain data.

deprecationHeaders.rule: A deprecated external operation returns RFC 9745 Deprecation, an RFC 8594 Sunset not earlier than the deprecation date when retirement is scheduled, and a Link relation rel="deprecation" to migration guidance. Deprecation alone does not change operation behavior.

migration.legacyEnvelopeRule: Every active /api/v1 operation uses the canonical success, cursor-page and error envelopes. B1-B13 response and envelope components are compatibility-only payload definitions and must not be referenced as an operation-level envelope.

x-p1r-state-machine.statusSeparation: session status never aliases attempt.status or report.status

itemRulePins.description: Learner-safe immutable answer-rule version/digest pins; the sealed rule reference and answer value are not exposed.

B10AttemptSubmission.description: Closed protected candidate-response union. The scoring boundary receives one explicit response shape and a digest; client score/rule authority is rejected.

B10Attempt.description: Assessment attempt lifecycle only. It does not own learning mastery, SRS, reward or progression state.

x-p1r-state-machine.statusSeparation: attempt status never aliases session.status or report.status

B10CheckpointRequest.description: Deprecated attempt-scoped checkpoint adapter request. New callers use B10AssessmentSessionCheckpointRequest.

B10Checkpoint.description: Deprecated attempt-scoped checkpoint adapter acknowledgement. It is not the canonical session checkpoint.

B10AssessmentReport.description: Versioned assessment report. It is bound to one session, attempt and submission, and never owns mastery/SRS facts.

x-p1r-state-machine.statusSeparation: report status never aliases session.status or attempt.status

B11Error.description: Compatibility error payload for existing media and notification operations. New or migrated operations use ApiError inside ApiErrorEnvelope.

checksumSha256.description: 只传校验摘要；媒体对象不在 API 响应中。

reference.description: 短时授权引用；不得写入日志或事件。

payloadHash.description: 只传 hash，不传离线原文。

B12Error.description: Compatibility error payload for existing gamification, social and notification operations. New or migrated operations use ApiError inside ApiErrorEnvelope.

B13Problem.description: Compatibility error payload for existing commerce, admin and analytics operations. New or migrated operations use ApiError inside ApiErrorEnvelope.

code.description: 仅通过 TLS 短暂传输，服务端只保存 hash，日志和事件禁止记录原文。

token.description: 一次性短时确认令牌；仅允许通过 TLS 进入内存请求头，不得写入日志、数据库、URL 或客户端持久化。

password.description: TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.
TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.

refreshToken.description: TLS only; optional native credential; Web sends HttpOnly cookie; 禁止日志或 Web storage 保存。

resetToken.description: TLS only; one-time credential; 禁止日志或明文持久化。

newPassword.description: TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.

B8AuthTokenResponse.x-compatibility-role: Legacy broad token response retained so existing generated-client imports remain source-compatible. New authentication operations use B8AuthTokenEnvelope with an explicit transport discriminator.

accessToken.description: TLS only; IAM-signed RS256 JWT; 禁止日志或 Web storage 保存。

refreshToken.description: TLS only; native-only rotated opaque credential; Web receives an HttpOnly cookie; 禁止日志。

authTransport.description: Optional legacy discriminator. New clients use the required discriminator on B8WebAuthTokenResponse or B8NativeAuthTokenResponse.

deviceId.description: Optional public device id; server generates one when absent.

ApiResponseMeta.title: Canonical API response metadata
ApiResponseMeta.description: Mandatory response metadata for newly created or migrated public operations. requestId and traceId are also returned as response headers.

ApiCursorPageMeta.title: Canonical cursor page metadata
ApiCursorPageMeta.description: Cursor pagination metadata for every active list* operation and any other active operation declaring Cursor. nextCursor is null when there is no next page; hasMore must agree with nextCursor; cursor state must not be duplicated in data.

data.description: Operation-specific successful result. Domain schemas define this value; no caller-provided authorization fact is echoed as trusted data.

Operation-specific cursor-page data. Collection operations normally return an item array; compound synchronization receipts may return an object while all cursor state remains in meta. Each operation declares x-pagination with the canonical Cursor, PageSize and ApiCursorPageMeta references.

B8WebDeviceInput.description: WEB_COOKIE request device boundary for browser Web and mobile H5. The server derives authorization facts independently of this device declaration.

B8NativeDeviceInput.description: NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE request device boundary for iOS, Android and native iPad runtimes. The server derives authorization facts independently of this device declaration.

password.description: TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.
TLS only; never log, persist plaintext, or return.

B8WebRefreshRequest.description: WEB_COOKIE refresh input. The opaque Refresh Token is sent only by the HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite cookie; JSON must not contain refreshToken.

refreshToken.description: TLS only; explicit native refresh credential. Store only in Keychain or Keystore; localStorage, sessionStorage, uni-app ordinary storage and plaintext fallbacks are prohibited.

B8WebAuthTokenResponse.description: WEB_COOKIE authentication result. Refresh Token is intentionally absent from JSON and is returned only by the HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite Set-Cookie header.

accessToken.description: TLS only; IAM-signed RS256 JWT. Keep in memory only; never log or store in Web storage.

B8NativeAuthTokenResponse.description: NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE authentication result. The explicit Refresh Token is required and may only be written to Keychain or Keystore; all ordinary storage and plaintext fallbacks are prohibited.

accessToken.description: TLS only; IAM-signed RS256 JWT. Keep in memory only; never log or store in ordinary storage.

refreshToken.description: TLS only; rotated opaque credential. Persist only in Keychain or Keystore; localStorage, sessionStorage, uni-app ordinary storage and plaintext fallbacks are prohibited.

B8AuthTokenEnvelope.description: Canonical ApiSuccessEnvelope with an explicitly transport-discriminated authentication data payload.

digest.description: Digest of the server-published consent document, never a client authority value.

B8PdpPrincipalContext.x-trust-boundary: All values are read by the calling PEP from an independently validated IAM JWT/session context and remain subject to IAM PDP validation; client fields cannot populate this object.

B8PdpResourceContext.x-trust-boundary: The calling resource-owner service supplies only facts it owns and signs/attests their provenance through its trusted service identity. IAM denies when owner or tenant provenance is missing or inconsistent.

B8TrustedServiceIdentityContext.x-server-derived: Validated from B8ServiceIdentity, not trusted from an arbitrary body field.

B8RolePermissionBinding.description: Versioned RBAC binding. It becomes authoritative only after independent approval and activation of the containing policy version; request payloads never change the caller's current authority.

requiredPermissions.description: Permissions resolved from the active server-side role binding; a client-supplied permission never satisfies this requirement.

B8PolicyDocument.x-policy-language: declarative-only; executable scripts, network callbacks and client-supplied authority expressions are prohibited

roleBindings.description: RBAC permission sets managed through the same immutable, independently approved policy lifecycle.

B8PdpAdultGateContext.description: Strict server-authoritative adult context required by the new PDP. The legacy public response keeps its historical required set for additive client compatibility.

B8PdpConsentContext.description: Strict required-consent context used by the new PDP; absent or stale facts are denied.

B8PdpAuthorizationDecisionResponse.description: Strict decision payload for the new PDP; compatibility clients may continue reading the legacy decision schema during migration.

B9PublishScheduleInput.description: 排期发布的乐观绑定快照。客户端只能提交版本、校验报告、双审记录和版权快照的引用及版本；content-service 必须在接收时和到期执行时重新核对 owner facts，绑定字段本身不是授权或运行时事实。

B9ScheduledPublishTask.description: 服务端只读的排期发布任务。客户端不能提交、伪造或推进 status，也不能把任务状态当作运行时发布证明；处理、重试、失败和恢复沿用 M1-007 recovery 契约，不在 B9 复制第二套处理状态机。

requestId.description: 创建或幂等重放该任务的服务端 request correlation ID；客户端不能伪造。

traceId.description: 贯穿命令受理、排期执行和审计记录的服务端 trace correlation ID；客户端不能伪造。

recoveryTaskId.description: 仅为服务端已创建的 workflow 恢复引用；不表示恢复已执行或运行时成功。

B9ScheduledPublishTaskRef.description: 命令受理或后台状态中的排期任务只读引用。处理、重试和失败恢复由 M1-007 recovery 负责，不在此引用复制第二套状态机。

B9SessionContentPin.description: 学习 session 对内容版本的服务端固定关系。仅表达版本引用和可用性，不返回已移除内容正文、答案或版权证据；UNAVAILABLE 时客户端不得静默回退到其他版本。

B9OffsetDateTime.description: RFC3339 绝对时间；必须带 Z 或显式 UTC offset，禁止无时区的本地时间。

B9ScheduledPublishTaskId.description: content-service 服务端生成的排期发布任务 ID。

B9DisplayTimeZone.description: IANA tz database 标识，仅用于后台展示和排期解释；实际执行以 scheduledAt 的绝对时间为准。

B9ContentValidationReportId.description: 服务端生成的内容校验报告引用；客户端只能提交乐观绑定，不能把它当作授权或运行证明。

B9RightsSnapshotId.description: 服务端生成的版权快照引用；客户端只能提交乐观绑定，服务端必须重新核对有效期和 owner。

B9AuditId.description: 服务端生成的不可变审计记录引用。

B9EvidenceVersion.description: 校验、审核或版权快照的单调版本；不得由客户端降级或重用旧版本绕过服务端重查。

B10ActiveSessionAttemptPin.description: Immutable pin used after an assessment session or attempt starts. The contentVersionId/contentEpoch/snapshotId/snapshotHash identity never changes. Emergency rights, security or legal removal returns UNAVAILABLE instead of a silent fallback.

MediaExpectedObject.description: Client declaration only. Provider/worker verification remains authoritative.

MediaUploadIntentCompleteRequest.description: Opaque provider completion reference. Client object facts are not authoritative.

MediaSubtitleTrack.description: Artifact metadata only. Official subtitle text and review remain content-service facts.

SpeakingRecordingCompleteRequest.description: Opaque completion reference; client integrity, malware and AI claims are prohibited.

SpeakingRecordingDeleteReceipt.x-owner-receipt-rule: purgeReceiptRef is required only after owner-confirmed DELETED; all non-deleted states forbid purge success.

recordingRef.description: Null when microphone permission was denied and the learner completed silent practice.

MediaFallbackAlternative.x-availability-rule: AVAILABLE requires an opaque contentRef and reasonCode=NONE; UNAVAILABLE requires a non-NONE reasonCode.

B10AssessmentItemRulePin.description: Per-item immutable answer-rule metadata. The fields identify a sealed rule contract and are not answer values.

B10ReasonTrace.description: Learner-safe structured explanation trace. It cannot include candidate response text, an answer key or a sealed rule value.

B10ObjectiveOutcome.description: Learner-safe deterministic objective outcome. It is an assessment fact, not a learning-service mastery or SRS fact.

B10SelfRatingOutcome.description: Learner self-rating only. It deliberately has no objectiveNumerator, objectiveDenominator or scoreBucket.

B10ManualReviewOutcome.description: Manual-review outcome status only. A pending or subjective review cannot be represented as an objective score.

B10AssessmentOutcome.description: Discriminated assessment outcome. Only the OBJECTIVE branch carries an objective score summary.

B10CandidateResponse.description: Closed candidate-response union. The protected scoring boundary accepts only these explicit response forms.

B10ProtectedDraft.description: Protected pre-submission candidate draft. It must be encrypted or equivalently protected at rest and is never emitted to Outbox, analytics or logs.

B10AssessmentSessionCheckpointRequest.description: Canonical session checkpoint command. baseStateVersion, checkpointVersion and client sequence are concurrency facts; protectedDraft is not an assessment submission.

B10AssessmentCheckpoint.description: Canonical session-level checkpoint acknowledgement. It is not an attempt or report fact.

m2RuntimeGaps.description: WebFlux currently disables CSRF and lacks the exact Origin/Referer profile enforcement.
Verifier-disabled public-path handling is not proven to equal the canonical anonymous route set.
Distributed rate limiting is disabled by default and needs Redis failure evidence.
The bounded in-memory audit sink is not durable audit-service evidence.
Application rejection of /internal does not prove domain service ports are network-isolated.
Real browser, JWKS rotation, cross-process and network-isolation evidence remains required.

transportSelector.serverCrossCheck: The server must fail closed when the selected transport conflicts with the device class or trusted client context.

webH5.request: Refresh credential is sent only by the HttpOnly-Secure-SameSite cookie.
webH5.response: Refresh credential is returned only by Set-Cookie and is absent from JSON data.

native.request: Refresh credential is an explicit JSON body field on the NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE variant.
native.response: Refresh credential is a required JSON data field on the NATIVE_SECURE_STORAGE variant.
native.storage: Keychain-or-Keystore-only; localStorage, sessionStorage, uni-app ordinary storage and any plaintext fallback are prohibited.

x-b8-compatibility.rule: Only iam-service may mint tokens. Compatibility routes are historical-only, cannot mint tokens, and fail closed.

x-b8-iam-policy-governance.authorizationModel: RBAC permission sets plus ABAC policy evaluation

clientAuthority.rule: Client-supplied values are assertions or selectors only. They never establish authorization and cannot expand an allow decision.

principal.source: iam-service derived from a validated IAM JWT, server-owned session/device facts, active policy and revocation state

adultGate.revalidation: required when the authoritative policy, evidence or eligibility state is stale, revoked or otherwise uncertain

consent.authority: iam-service server record bound to a published document version and digest
consent.withdrawal: applies documented restriction, revocation and revalidation effects before protected capability use

pepPdp.normalPath: domain-service local PEP: validated JWT plus local resource facts plus versioned policy bundle or bounded security cache
pepPdp.trustedInternalCaller: service identity is independently authenticated and bound to the PEP service

policyControlPlane.separationOfDuties: A policy author, contributor or submitter cannot independently approve the same version. Activation requires an independently approved immutable version; no client role or approver identifier is trusted.
policyControlPlane.audit: Every read decision and mutating lifecycle action is linked by requestId, traceId, decisionId or auditId.
policyControlPlane.cacheInvalidation: Activation and revocation publish a versioned cache invalidation receipt. PEPs deny protected actions until they can prove a non-revoked applicable policy version.

apiSemantics.errorResponses: ApiBadRequest, ApiUnauthorized, ApiForbidden, ApiNotFound, ApiConflict, ApiUnprocessableEntity, ApiServiceUnavailable or ApiGatewayTimeout as applicable
apiSemantics.idempotency: Every persistent write requires Idempotency-Key; decision and policy-bundle reads do not create a domain fact.
